observations.visible: Seller explicitly labels redonda; photo projects a rounded/circular lens obliquely with convex/bulged visible face and finite peripheral wall/rim. It is a translucent orange part alone on a light surface, not a whole indicator or metal reflector.
observations.limits: Projected ellipse does not measure true ovality. Actual diameter, sag, edge thickness, section radii and seating ledge depth not calibrated.

observations.visible: Several broad parallel band-like optical regions can be seen through the amber face, separated by brighter/darker edges. Fine ribs/textured border visible around part of the circumference; stepped/faceted regions near other rim sectors.
observations.limits: Transparent overlays and oblique view do not resolve which relief belongs to inside versus outside, exact counts/pitch/cross-section or refractive prescription. Do not create an invented generic reflector behind them.

observations.visible: Local enlarged rounded pocket/boss near one side and a small opposing edge feature/notch are visible; standalone lens and assembledPF views together constrain the presence of a localized fastener region.
observations.limits: Hole through/blind shape, seating depth, backside lug extent and exact fit with housing remain unknown; do not certify hidden screw socket or complete mirror geometry.

observations.visible: Raised/indented moulded lettering/approval-like marks visible on the face.
observations.limits: No full authoritative transcription or actual approval inferred from pixels. Do not copy supplier/approval marks as game textures or treat them as dimensional data.
No certified polymer grade/IOR/transmission/spectral colour or emissive property from this lighting. Orange colour of the photo is not a calibrated material sample.
